# Session Documentation Capture: Lead Lab Session Lifecycle Build

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

The local session-lifecycle increment is implemented, locally validated, manually checked by the PM, and recorded as ready for Measure. This capture documents the plan, build, defects, fixes, evidence, and remaining control boundaries.

## Session Outcome

| Area                   | Recorded result                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Session administration | Draft creation, full-field editing, separate publish and unpublish, archive and restore, administrator visibility, participant visibility enforcement, and protected-material replacement implemented. |
| Video playback         | The initial playback-load defect was fixed with deterministic YouTube API loading and a session-keyed player remount. The PM later confirmed video playback works.                                     |
| Lifecycle navigation   | The stale admin Classroom status was traced to Inertia sidebar prefetch caching. Dynamic sidebar prefetch was removed and the lifecycle acceptance path was tested.                                    |
| Edit feedback          | Edit submission uses browser-compatible method spoofing, clears on successful navigation, and reports success through the existing Inertia toast.                                                      |
| Final user check       | PM confirmation in the current conversation: "When I check the app everything is working now."                                                                                                         |

## Session Record

### Direction And Scope

- `D-16 (Prioritize session lifecycle administration and defer participant account lifecycle work)` was captured as proposed before the build.
- `CHG-06 (Re-sequence the next local build to session lifecycle administration and defer participant account lifecycle work)` was captured as proposed before the build.
- `ACT-13 (Implement and verify session lifecycle administration)` was captured as proposed before the build.
- Participant creation or invitation, temporary-password enforcement, participant account lifecycle expansion, authentication and participant-data reconciliation, Gate 1, staging, and production work remained outside this session increment.

### Build Work

- Added `archived_at` persistence for learning sessions.
- Added administrator routes and actions for edit, publish, unpublish, archive, and restore.
- Changed new session creation to save a draft; publication is a separate action.
- Added full-field edit support and replacement of the first stored private material.
- Excluded archived sessions from participant lists, dashboard data, detail access, and downloads while retaining administrator access.
- Added admin status badges and lifecycle controls.
- Added server-side success flash messages and automatic session-list reload behavior.
- Added a shared, race-safe YouTube API loader, playback error state, and session-keyed remount behavior.
- Removed prefetch from dynamic sidebar navigation so `/admin/classroom` is fetched fresh after a lifecycle change.

### Defects And Resolutions

| Evidence or symptom                                                                                              | Root cause                                                                                                                                  | Resolution                                                                                                            | Result                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Edit stayed at `Saving...`; `/Users/agnojf/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Screenshot 2026-08-20 at 2.47.43 PM.png` | The edit form sent multipart data through `PATCH`, a fragile browser and PHP upload boundary.                                               | Submit the edit as `POST` with `_method=PATCH`; clear the temporary transform after completion.                       | Focused edit and resource-replacement test passes.     |
| Video required refresh; `/Users/agnojf/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Screenshot 2026-08-20 at 3.06.19 PM.png`     | YouTube API callback and iframe/player lifecycle could race during Inertia navigation and React Strict Mode.                                | Use a shared API-loading promise with readiness polling, a keyed player remount, and a visible load-error state.      | PM confirmed video playback works.                     |
| Lifecycle status did not consistently appear in `/admin/classroom`                                               | The sidebar prefetched `/admin/classroom` and could serve a stale cached page after the status mutation.                                    | Remove prefetch from dynamic sidebar links, retain explicit lifecycle reload, and add the cross-page acceptance test. | Publish and archive navigation status assertions pass. |
| Edit form did not clear and gave no confirmation                                                                 | Inertia preserved form state after the redirect, and admin mutations used regular session flash data instead of the existing toast channel. | Set non-preserved edit navigation and use `Inertia::flash('toast', ...)` for admin session actions.                   | PM confirmed final application behavior works.         |
